title: Canon plugin manifest (DRAFT, non-normative)
description: Describes one plugin that derives a vendor-specific structure from a canon. Standalone: it does not extend canon.schema.json, which is normative and closed (additionalProperties: false).

plugin.description: Plugin id. Must equal the name of the directory that holds this manifest.

contract.description: Version of CONTRACT.md this manifest was written against.

derives.description: Kinds of vendor structure the plugin derives from a canon, e.g. element-name, property-schema.

entry.description: Path of the plugin's check entry point, relative to the plugin directory.

status.description: A stub must exit 2 and must never exit 0. Only an implemented check that has been shown to fail on bad input may report 'implemented'.

layers.description: Which layers the check covers. A live layer may only be weaker than the static one.

evidence.description: tested = run and shown to pass and fail; documented = stated in a vendor document, not run; observed = seen in one real read; design = a proposal with no evidence.

claims.description: Every behavioural claim the plugin makes about the vendor, with how it is known.
